papers.title: Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows
papers.desc: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible.

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.desc: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs.

papers.title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
papers.desc: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size.

papers.title: Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated
papers.desc: Large language model (LLM) assistants are being deployed to clinicians across health systems, and judgments about their readiness rest largely on benchmark scores, most of them derived from examination questions or curated cases.

papers.title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
papers.desc: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood.

papers.title: Self-Preservation in Language Models
papers.desc: Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities.

papers.title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
papers.desc: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations.

papers.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models
papers.desc: A latent recurrent language model applies a shared block of layers repeatedly, so one checkpoint can trade inference compute for accuracy by changing the loop count.

papers.title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
papers.desc: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates salient factors specific to the target from common content shared by both.

papers.title: Mental-Models for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.desc: Large foundation models have accelerated progress toward general-purpose agents that interact with humans and other agents through language and multimodal signals.

papers.title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
papers.desc: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches.

papers.title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
papers.desc: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent.

papers.title: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
papers.desc: Reconstructing complete, scene-aligned 3D objects from casual images requires integrating sparse, uncertain observations and inferring surfaces hidden by occlusions.

papers.title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers.

papers.title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
papers.desc: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion.
